title: Release punch-list session
notes: Session dominated by pending work items with a late-session reprioritization. Tests todo-type recall breadth and whether reprioritization is captured.

turns.text: Let's do a punch-list session — what's left before we can cut the v0.9.0 release?

Sure, from the tracking doc, remaining items are: (1) write migration docs for the new archival tiers feature, (2) add a doctor check for the new tag-hygiene tier2 flag, (3) backfill CHANGELOG entries for the last 3 merged PRs, (4) verify the Windows service uninstall path on a clean VM, (5) bump package.json version to 0.9.0 and tag.
Add one more: we still need to decide whether archival defaults to enabled or stays opt-in for existing installs.
Added as item 6: decide archival.enabled default for upgrades (currently opt-in/false) before the release, since flipping it silently could archive memories users didn't expect to lose.
Good catch — flag that one as higher priority than the doc items.
Noted — reordered so the archival-default decision and the Windows uninstall verification are top priority; docs and CHANGELOG backfill can slip a day if needed.

gold_atoms.text: Write migration docs for the new archival tiers feature before the v0.9.0 release.
Add a doctor check for the new tag-hygiene tier2 flag before the v0.9.0 release.
Backfill CHANGELOG entries for the last 3 merged PRs before the v0.9.0 release.
Verify the Windows service uninstall path on a clean VM before the v0.9.0 release.
Bump package.json version to 0.9.0 and tag for release.
Decide whether archival.enabled defaults to true or stays opt-in (false) for existing installs before the release — flipping it silently could archive memories users didn't expect to lose.
The archival-default decision and the Windows uninstall verification were reprioritized above the docs/CHANGELOG backfill items, which can slip a day if needed.
